row.body: Transfer window: after road access ends. Return copy to sender. Reverse: “Bread for Mother, no crust if it is still warm.”
row.title: Courier card with a late return
row.gloss: A courier's card sets a return after the access window.
row.rival_reading: A field-delivery schedule could run past a road restriction; the late return line does not identify who changed access.

rows.note: Two independent blind reads (DR-20260928-NOHELP-REVIEW-FAST) both missed the declared lean (declared B; votes A 2, B 0, neither 0). Rework so one detail tilts it to its own side while the rival reading stays possible. Keep place, spot, lean, rival, pieces and axioms.

row.body: The map's route turns away from the gate. A key tag marked “last run” is tied to its corner, with a thread long enough to reach the road line.
row.title: The key marked for the last run
row.gloss: A last-run key points toward a route that no longer reaches its gate.
row.rival_reading: A delayed response crew could carry a key and route map after access changed; the tag could also belong to a field delivery.
